meta.description: Calls the Asset Manager automation API (asset_manager.automation.api) every 15 minutes: POST /ingest/run, which walks Drive raw_docs/ and chunks/embeds/upserts any new or changed files into Chroma (asset_manager.ingestion.ingest.run_ingestion). A polling schedule trigger is used rather than Drive's native push-notification trigger — simpler to set up and more reliable, and cheap to poll often since ingestion is idempotent (unchanged files are skipped via content-hash) and already resilient to individual bad files (one unsupported/corrupt file is recorded in failed_files and skipped, not a batch-aborting crash — see ingest.py). Two alert paths, both distinct from anything the API can notify about on its own since ingestion has no SlackWebhookNotifier wired in: a non-200 response (API down or erroring) alerts via 'Alert: API Unreachable'; a 200 response that still reports failed > 0 (specific files that didn't parse) alerts via 'Alert: Ingestion Files Failed', naming the files, while the rest of the batch still completed normally.
